Your personal data has been redacted. The report will be deleted once the issue has been identified and fixed.

Kitsune is committed to respecting your privacy. We don\'t collect or store your conversations on our servers — they\'re encrypted on your device and only sent to our AI providers in real time to generate a response. Each provider applies its own retention period, detailed in our privacy policy.
All your conversations are stored LOCALLY. If you uninstall Kitsune without exporting your data first, there will be no way to recover your data.

Kitsune focuses on immersion. You will have the opportunity to see for yourself, but Kitsune has a series of unique technologies to make your experience as immersive as possible. In case of a problem, it will always be possible to create an anonymous bug report.

In Settings, you can enter your first name, last name, age and other details so personas address you personally in the story. This information is used only to personalize your own conversations (sent as context to the AI to generate responses about you) — it\'s never logged, stored, or retained by us beyond your device.

I develop Kitsune alone, in my spare time. I try to keep prices low and competitive compared to other AI roleplay apps. I welcome all your suggestions via the \"Improve Kitsune\" tab and you can vote for your favorite proposals. If you have the means and wish to support me on the Kitsune AI adventure, you can make a donation via the app and Google Play.
Kitsune is a role-playing and AI-assisted storytelling application, developed with passion by a single independent developer.

• All your data is stored locally on your device, encrypted
• No content is sent to third-party servers without your consent
• Conversations are transmitted securely (HTTPS/TLS) to our AI providers solely to generate a reply — never stored or logged on our side, though each provider applies its own retention period (see our privacy policy)
• You have full control over your data

• Create custom personas and universes
• Immersive AI conversations
• Memory system for coherent stories
• Marketplace to share and discover content
• Proposal system to improve the app

Kitsune is free and will remain so. However, development requires time and resources. You can support the project in several ways:

• Buy Ofudas in the store
• Make a donation via the 'Support' section
• Suggest improvements and vote
• Share the app with your friends

Your feedback is essential to improve Kitsune. Feel free to:

• Use the 'Improve Kitsune' section to suggest ideas
• Report bugs via the help menu
• Share your experiences with the community
